workflow: A caller constructs an executable representation whose instruction data is longer than its associated source-location metadata.
A position-inspection operation parses the metadata assuming it contains a valid entry for each instruction range.
The truncated metadata violates the decoder’s boundary and encoding invariants during iteration.
An internal consistency check aborts the process instead of reporting malformed metadata as a recoverable input error.
summary: Malformed location metadata triggers fatal decoder validation
decision_reason: The bug materially matches the existing workflow: deliberately malformed encoded location metadata is later decoded under assumed invariants, and the decoder asserts fatally rather than rejecting the invalid representation recoverably.
